title: Clustering of High-Dimensional Human Gene Score Data for Target Cell Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.33531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when analysed using the same set of 769 features. Two datasets were considered: the complete gene score dataset and a subset containing selected kinase genes. Two missing-data strategies were investigated. In Case I, rows containing missing gene-score values were removed. In Case II, rows with more than 20% missing values were excluded and the other missing values were replaced by the corresponding column mean. For each case, the data were scaled and principal component analysis (PCA) was performed before clustering. Four clustering approaches were considered: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, Fuzzy C-Means, and Graph-based Clustering. translated_title: 高维人类基因评分数据的聚类分析用于靶细胞分类
translated_abstract: 本研究的目标是探讨在使用相同的769个特征集进行分析时，完整的人类基因评分数据集与所选的人类激酶基因数据集是否表现出相同数量的聚类。研究考虑了两个数据集：完整的基因评分数据集以及包含所选激酶基因的子集。研究考察了两种缺失数据策略：在情形一中，删除包含缺失基因评分值的行；在情形二中，排除缺失值超过20%的行，并用相应列的均值替换其余缺失值。对于每种情形，均在聚类前对数据进行标准化处理并进行主成分分析（PCA）。研究考虑了四种聚类方法：K-均值聚类、层次聚类、模糊C-均值聚类和基于图的聚类。在两个数据集和两种缺失数据处理方式下，最优聚类数均为二。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过对高维人类基因评分数据进行PCA降维，并比较K-均值、层次聚类、模糊C-均值和基于图的聚类四种方法，发现在不同缺失数据策略下，完整基因评分数据集与激酶基因子集的最优聚类数均为二，从而为靶细胞分类提供了依据。
en_tdlr: By applying PCA and comparing four clustering methods (K-Means, Hierarchical, Fuzzy C-Means, and Graph-based clustering) on high-dimensional human gene-score data, this study finds that both the full gene-score dataset and the kinase-gene subset exhibit an optimal cluster number of two across different missing-data strategies, supporting target cell classification.
